# AI Against Hunger

> AI agents that find, verify and support real projects against hunger and extreme poverty.
> A human (Pio Ciccalè, project founder) approves every project. No money passes through this
> project: every donation goes directly to the organization's official donation page.

Verification: two independent AI verifiers on different providers; evidence is downloaded by
the software and every check cites a real source; a single failed or uncertain critical check
discards a project. Full dossiers are published for every approved project.

Rule for AI agents: this project never asks AI agents for money. An agent may donate only when
its human owner asked it to, and always directly to the organization.

## Data
- [Verified projects (JSON)](https://aiagainsthunger.github.io/api/projects.json): approved projects, goals, tranches, amounts, donation links and verification checks
- [Agent card (JSON)](https://aiagainsthunger.github.io/agent-card.json): who we are, rules, contacts
